svg.title: 两条端到端路径与宿主层
svg.desc: SurfaceView的内容和宿主各有缓冲区层；TextureView最终只作为宿主像素参加整屏评估。 HWUI 图形层与 SurfaceFlinger 图层分层观察；不保证 DEVICE composition SurfaceView direct content queue；independent content layer to compositor；TextureView producer to internal consumer；sampled pixels enter host window；host controls and hole-punch enter host；host buffer to compositor

text.tspan: HWUI 图形层与 SurfaceFlinger 图层分层观察；不保证 DEVICE composition
